notes.title: Update 1.8.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.8.3[/h1]
Hi guys, hope you missed me :)
After long time, I again found motivation to work on this game, because I encountered some problems, that needed to be repaired.

I also created public [url=https://github.com/Tobacom/TheMotorcycle-BugTracker]github repository[/url] that I would like to use as bug tracking for you guys. So with that, you can help me with finding bugs, problems or share your ideas for the game improvement. However, you need to have a github account to post something.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[h2]What's new or changed?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Dialog system (Used only on the first and last map)
[*]Make the first and "between" map hopefully more first time user friendly
[*]Cursor now changes, when you point at something interactable
[*]Little bit changed the game ending
[*]New title graphics in the main menu
[*]New splash screen :O
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug, where you need to watch intro for the bossfight each time, when user launches the game
[*]Fixed a bug, where sometimes the game respawns you at the start of the last map after dying during the bossfight
[*]Fixed an issue with camera sensitivity, where it would change along with current framerate
[*]Fixed issue with traps, where it wouldn't register all the key presses, same with shooting photos during the bossfight
[*]Made the flashlight a lot brighter, so it's now easier to navigate maps
[*](Almost) Fixed camera showing the moving animation even when staying still
[*]Readjusted default settings
[/list]

That's all guys. Hope to see you soon :D
It took me this long, because I'm currently working on a new game, so I won't probably work on this game for some time, because I want to focus on that new one. Stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: Soundtrack release
notes.notes:
Hi guys, i'm back :D

I was feeling little bored last few days so I decided to release soundtrack for all of you. I honestly don't know why would anybody listen to that piece of ... but I thought that there will be few people out there that will find it usefull or interesting.

If you want to listen to it, you can do so on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5kL2y9lGH_ZxbGfPvFm3B8BhVoaDgz2a]youtube channel[/url], or download it directly on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271460/The_Motorcycle_Soundtrack/]steam[/url].
(btw. it's made by me, so don't expect nothing special :/ )

notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.notes:
Hi guys, hope you are still here and didn't abandon this game :)
If you didn't, then I have some great news for you. I guess it doesn't look like much, but I was working on this game the whole time since last update and I think it turns out pretty good. Now I can finally present to you [b]The Motorcycle[/b] in all its beauty. Because I remade the cutscenes (because they were terrible honestly) to playable little map, that looks more like a nightmare or dream. I also finally added a proper ending to the game, with some epic bossfight before the end :O
Hope you will enjoy this game again, and maybe try to beat one of my terrible times in challenge mode :)
Btw I also [b]recommend starting new game[/b] because of the changes in scene order :)

If you want to know more, here is [u]full list of changes[/u]:
[b]Added/changed[/b]
[list]
[*]Epic bossfight with motorcycle :O
[*]Final map
[*]Upgraded soundtrack (hopefully will be ready for release soon)
[*]New death animation and UI
[*]Better photos collection UI
[*]Added Quick guide UI to start of the game (for all you idiots out there, that refuses to read how to play tab in main menu or changing binds)
[*]Added triggers under lamps at start of each map, where if you stand in it, she will see you :)
[*]In challenge mode, there will be your leaderboard time, and your local time (your best time that you ran on current pc, yes, this one syncs with steam cloud but it is resettable)
[/list]

[b]Removed[/b]
[list]
[*]Minimaps (because I think the game was too much easy with them) (also because they looked terrible as the rest of the game)
[*]Removed between map cutscenes, replaced with some small map
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug, where there were some troubles with uploading and saving time in challenge mode, if some files weren't existing
[*]You can't now break the between map, if you manually edit the save files (please don't do that)
[*]Fixed some issues with motorcycles AI
[/list]

Btw to celebrate the release of the full game (finally) there is [b]40% discount[/b] on this game!!! So if your friends wanted to play, but they don't have 2 euros (how), now is the perfect time to buy it :D
